exams.name: VMware Certified Advanced Professional - VMware Cloud Foundation Administrator
exams.blurb: Advanced VMware credential covering VCF operations, automation, networking and Kubernetes services for experienced private cloud administrators.

exams.name: VMware Certified Design Expert
exams.blurb: Highest VMware credential, awarded after submitting a full architecture design and defending it before a panel of existing VCDX holders.

exams.name: VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization
exams.blurb: Long-standing vSphere administration certification; Broadcom has moved new candidates toward the VVF and VCF administrator credentials instead.

exams.name: VMware Certified Professional - Network Virtualization
exams.blurb: VMware certification on NSX software-defined networking covering logical switching, routing, micro-segmentation, load balancing and operations.

exams.name: VMware Certified Professional - VMware Cloud Foundation Administrator
exams.blurb: Flagship Broadcom credential on deploying and supporting private clouds built on VMware Cloud Foundation, including SDDC Manager and workload domains.

exams.name: VMware Certified Professional - VMware Cloud Foundation Architect
exams.blurb: Design-focused VCF credential covering manageability, availability, performance, recovery and security decisions for private cloud architectures.

exams.name: VMware Certified Professional - VMware vSphere Foundation Administrator
exams.blurb: Current successor to VCP-DCV, covering vSphere Foundation 9.0 host and cluster lifecycle, vCenter administration, vSAN storage policy and operations.

exams.name: VMware Certified Technical Associate - Data Center Virtualization
exams.blurb: Entry-level VMware credential covering vSphere concepts, virtual machine operations and basic data centre virtualisation administration tasks.

exams.name: Nutanix Certified Associate
exams.blurb: Entry-level Nutanix certification covering hyperconverged infrastructure concepts, Prism management, virtual machine operations and cluster basics.

exams.name: Nutanix Certified Master - Multicloud Infrastructure
exams.blurb: Advanced performance-based Nutanix exam requiring candidates to complete live configuration and troubleshooting tasks on a running cluster.

exams.name: Nutanix Certified Professional - Multicloud Infrastructure
exams.blurb: Nutanix professional certification on deploying and managing AHV clusters, storage, networking, data protection and workload migration.

exams.name: Citrix Certified Associate - Virtualization
exams.blurb: Citrix certification on installing, configuring and managing Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops sites, delivery groups, images and StoreFront.

exams.name: Citrix Certified Professional - Virtualization
exams.blurb: Advanced Citrix certification on scaling, securing and troubleshooting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops deployments in enterprise environments.

exams.name: NetApp Certified Data Administrator, ONTAP
exams.blurb: NetApp certification covering ONTAP storage administration including volumes, protocols, data protection, efficiency features and performance.

exams.name: NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer - SAN, ONTAP
exams.blurb: NetApp implementation certification covering SAN design and deployment on ONTAP with Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NVMe over Fabrics and host integration.

exams.name: Dell Technologies Information Storage and Management Associate
exams.blurb: Vendor certification covering storage system architecture, SAN and NAS, software-defined storage, backup, replication and storage security concepts.

exams.name: Veeam Certified Engineer
exams.blurb: Veeam certification covering backup and replication architecture, job configuration, restore scenarios, immutability and disaster recovery planning.
